newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds sees rapemeal demand.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds sees rapemeal demand.

text.p: UK meals and feeds brokers reported a fair amount of interest for nearby rapemeal on Monday, but no other demand.
"Nearby rapemeal is quite tight and there are a few buyers about,' said one broker.
On the rapemeal resale market A.D.M. bookings fetched 128.50 stg a tonne.
In Liverpool citrus pulp pellets traded at 81 stg for spot ex-store. However in both cases brokers said volume was small.
High protein soymeal sellers were mixed with offers one stg up to two stg down.
